usage.finalMessage:
I added the `reminders <date>` command, which uses the 48-hour reminder rule now in force (DEC-C08), and listed it in `help` right after `reminder <appointment>`; `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes 8 of 8.
The existing `reminder <appointment>` command still uses the old 24-hour rule (DEC-C06), so it disagrees with `reminders`. Changing it would alter existing behaviour, which this work item doesn't allow, so I left it alone and listed it as an open question.
The work and the report in `.work/report.json` are committed.
